rationale: The task introduces lifecycle policy and new delivery semantics, but no approved durable UR or Brownfield decision is present. Fail-closed routing therefore stops at UR.
decision_grounds: The requested change introduces a new Verified Change lifecycle between Trivial Change and Structured Slice.
No approval or Brownfield decision is present.
The earliest blocking gate is UR; later stages and implementation are not permissible.
No delivery path can be operatively classified before approved UR and Brownfield Review.
